在线用户的登录会话，清空后所有用户需重新登录: Sessions of online users. After clearing, all users must sign in again
登录用户的角色与权限，清空后下次请求自动重新加载: Roles and permissions of signed-in users, reloaded automatically on the next request after clearing
按字典类型缓存的字典数据: Dictionary data cached by dictionary type
按用户名记录的连续登录失败次数，达到上限时锁定账号；清空即解除锁定: Consecutive login failures per username; the account is locked at the limit. Clearing unlocks it
验证码答案，2 分钟内有效，校验一次后作废: Captcha answers, valid for 2 minutes and invalidated after one check
参数设置中修改过的参数，保存时自动清理: Settings changed in Settings, cleared automatically on save
按租户缓存的业务参数（修改过的），保存时自动清理: Changed business rules cached per tenant, cleared automatically on save
钉钉、企业微信、飞书应用的 access_token，按租户和平台缓存，修改集成: access_token of DingTalk, WeCom and Feishu apps, cached per tenant and platform and cleared when the integration settings change
钉钉、企业微信、飞书授权登录 / 绑定的 state，10 分钟内有效，使用一次: State of DingTalk, WeCom and Feishu login / binding authorizations, valid for 10 minutes and invalidated after use
缓存不存在或已过期: The cache entry does not exist or has expired
